# AccentPicker

> Lede 0.7.0's docs for AccentPicker, installed with it. Setup, and every item in the release: [README.md](README.md). Online: https://lede.cloudcompute.com/reference/accent-picker.md

Native radio inputs for ThemeProvider's accent presets, each with a swatch and a visible name.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @lede/accent-picker @lede/form-section
```

The command needs Lede's registry in `components.json`, as [README.md](README.md#use-it-in-a-shadcn-project) shows. It also installs the items [`lede-theme`](lede-theme.md), [`lede-utils`](lede-utils.md) and [`theme-provider`](theme-provider.md). It adds [`form-section`](https://lede.cloudcompute.com/reference/form-section.md) only because the example below imports it. The item's JSON, with each file's source, is https://lede.cloudcompute.com/r/v0.7.0/accent-picker.json.

## Import

```tsx
import { AccentPicker } from '@/components/lede/blocks/accent-picker';
```

## Files and exports

| Installs to | Import from | Exports |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `components/lede/blocks/accent-picker.tsx` | `@/components/lede/blocks/accent-picker` | `AccentPicker` (component), `AccentPickerProps` (type) |

## Props

Native radio inputs, one per accent preset, each with a visible name, so color is never the only cue. Place it inside a FormSection, whose `<legend>` names the group.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` (required) | `Preset` |  |  |
| `onValueChange` (required) | `(value: Preset) => void` |  |  |
| `name` | `string` |  | Radio group name. Defaults to a generated id. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

These props use types from other items:

- `Preset` is `'blue' | 'indigo' | 'teal' | 'green' | 'orange' | 'pink' | 'graphite'`, declared in [`theme-provider`](theme-provider.md#types).

## Example

The smallest working use, from the docs site:

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { AccentPicker } from '@/components/lede/blocks/accent-picker';
import { FormSection } from '@/components/lede/blocks/form-section';
import { ThemeProvider, type Preset } from '@/components/lede/theme-provider';

export function AccentSetting() {
  const [accent, setAccent] = useState<Preset>('blue');
  return (
    <ThemeProvider accent={accent}>
      <FormSection legend="Accent">
        <AccentPicker value={accent} onValueChange={setAccent} />
      </FormSection>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

Docs: [Blocks](https://lede.cloudcompute.com/blocks.md).
